description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


# Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.4.6

- Add text annotations directly to screenshot selections, and copy image paths from history.
- Recognize tables with live previews and corrections; preview LaTeX as recognition progresses.
- Use free translation and switch services quickly, with better preservation of text size.
- Copy or stitch multiple pins at once, show or hide other pins with a shake, and export the latest edits reliably.
- Choose which key types appear in recordings, including numbers, letters, control keys, and shortcuts.
- Smaller downloads and lower memory use when exporting, plus fixes for macOS focus and image dragging, toolbar placement, and screenshot editing.

## Quick macOS install

Copy into Terminal without `sudo`. Append `--edition mini` to install Mini.

```sh
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.4.6_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh
```

The installer verifies and locally signs the app. Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility when prompted. For Gitee downloads, replace `https://github.com` with `https://gitee.com` in the links and command above.
